entries.title: Novellae constitutiones inde ab anno 1220 usque ad captam urbem
entries.note: Head 'CPOLITANORUM IMPP. / CONSTANTINOPOLITANORUM IMPERATORUM NOVELLAE CONSTITUTIONES' lines 92102-92130 under header 1019 (92081). The Elenchus adds a note that novellae of emperors up to 1230 were published earlier (see the alphabetical index under CPOLITANI).

problems: Prolegomena items (Bandini Commentarius, Appendix, Index, Platina, Acta, Apostolius, Fabricius) are in roman-numeral columns; pg-colfind cannot map them, so bodyCol is null and bodyColRoman is given from OCR roman page headers read by eye (OCR digits like 'tcv', 'acvni', 'CiU', 'i EXXVIR').

OCR digit misreads in this volume: 3 as 5 and 5 as 3, 7 as 1, 4 as 1, 9 as 8/3 in both the Elenchus and the page headers; the 1131-1139 headers of the Monodia are read as 1151-1159 from the end-of-volume sequence.

The Elenchus text for the Iambi in obitu Theodorae Augustae item is garbled (OCR lines run into noise); its column 621 is read from the 'Ex Allatio De consensu, 621' fragment and the Ordo. Neither list prints a column for the Latin 'Idem liber' (Bessarion's own Latin version of De processione).
Elenchus and Ordo for Lascaris show transposed columns (Epistola ad Gattum 915/913, De scriptoribus Siculis 913/95).

Ordo-only Lascaris pieces entered with listedIn ordo-only: Prooemium ad libros de grammatica (Ordo '93', body 931), Epilogus ejusdem libri (937, unlocated), Epistola ad Jacobum Ximenium (939), De Quinto poeta argumenta (Ordo 942, body 945). The remaining Ordo pieces from De Poeta to the Epitaphium are listed as parts of the Elenchus's 'Fragmenta varia' (951) and are not body-confirmed.
Apparatus not entered (not in the Elenchus): the Monitum before Bessarion's Refutatio capitum (line 13279, the Elenchus' 'Vide Monitum praefixum') and the Monitum before the Defensiones (line 34762).
OCR page duplication: Fabricius title block repeated at lines 12213-12255; the Latin Idem liber and others appear once; first occurrences cited.
Greek flag is an automatic OCR count over 70 lines from the head; recheck at the plate before queue decisions. Pieces whose heading carries Greek on one half-page and Latin on the other show 'yes'.
The 'Theodori Gazae Liber de mensibus' parenthetical is entered as a crossref to PG 19 col. 1167 without a body check.
